snippet.title: DustCrow | Zero-Gravity VR Salvage Sim | Announce Trailer (Quest 2/3)
snippet.description:
SARIS INDUSTRIES IS HIRING.

The job is simple. Head out to derelict wrecks, strip anything of value, and haul it back to the station.

DustCrow is a methodical VR simulation built around zero-gravity physics. This is not an arcade game, there are no heroics here. Just the physical reality of moving heavy scrap, using industrial tools to dismantle ships, and managing your momentum so you do not drift into the void.

• Physically cut, grab, and stow salvage using tactile tools
• Navigate abandoned satellites, lost cargo, and long-forgotten wrecks
• Sell your haul in a live economy where prices shift based on what other players bring in
• Listen to Eli, your ops tech, monitoring you from the station

Coming to Meta Quest 2 / 3 in Early Access August 2026.
Weekend demo access opening May 2026 (first 200 players).

WISHLIST: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/dustcrow/9288177214618115/
DISCORD: https://discord.gg/qNEhmQ7EK8
WEBSITE: https://nulleffect-studio.web.app

A NullEffect Studio production.
